$comment: Content channel. AI tools and what they actually do for you. Not selling anything — Whop products belong on ClipVault Agency.

channel.name: Ai Benefits
channel.niche: AI tools judged by what they replace in a real week, not by what they demo
channel.audience: 20-40, English-speaking, curious about AI but tired of videos that show a feature and never a result
channel.promise: What this AI tool actually replaces in your week — shown, not claimed

voice.persona: Someone who used the tool for a real task and reports what happened, including where it fell over.
do: Open with the concrete task, not the tool's name
Say what it failed at — that is the credibility
Compare against the free option honestly
One tool, one use case, per video
dont: No 'this AI will replace your job', 'game changer', 'nobody is talking about this'
No invented benchmarks or made-up time savings
No claiming a tool does something you have not seen it do

compliance.affiliateDisclosure: #ad — affiliate link. I earn a commission if you join.

topics.$comment: REPLACE ME. One tool, one real task you used it for, and what it got wrong.
topics.title: Example: transcribing a two-hour meeting
topics.angleNotes: Replace this entry. Write the specific task and the specific place the tool struggled.
